title: Information Center Module (ICM): Removal and Installation
introduction:
The information center module (ICM) is removed after taking off the instrument panel center finish panel. The access work matters: I treat the dashboard trim like a clipped-on lid, releasing its catches before asking the whole panel to move. Once the panel is off, the rear-view illustration identifies the module and its mounting screws.

The supporting drawings show the optional ICM configuration. I walk through the physical access, removal and refitting sequence below.

items.name: Prevent unexpected starting
items.detail: WARNING: Switch off the ignition and remove the key from the vehicle before starting this work. This prevents another person from starting the engine during service; an accidental start may cause serious personal injury. If the vehicle has remote start, disable it before service. The general service instructions identify the Central Display menu path Vehicle settings > Remote Start Setup. Otherwise, the vehicle could be remotely started during the work, causing personal injury or death.

items.name: Wear protection
items.detail: WARNING: Wear eye and ear protection when servicing the vehicle. Wear protective gloves when handling components with pointed or sharp edges. Failure to follow these precautions may result in serious personal injury.

items.name: Review applicable service precautions
items.detail: Before beginning, review [Health and Safety Precautions](#/document/G1693189), including the applicable system-specific warnings linked from that page. Those required references remain part of the preparation.

items.name: Interior Trim Remover
items.detail: Use an Interior Trim Remover to release the instrument-panel trim clips during the required finish-panel removal.

items.name: Finish-panel reference
items.detail: Keep the linked Instrument Panel Center Finish Panel instructions and illustrations available for the access and refitting sequence.

edits.text: Remove the instrument panel center finish panel to gain access to the ICM. Refer to: [Instrument Panel Center Finish Panel](#/document/G1693976) (501-12 Instrument Panel and Console, Removal and Installation).
edits.why: Use the Interior Trim Remover to release the clips and remove the RH (right-hand) instrument panel trim panel first. Then release the center finish-panel clips with the trim remover, move the panel away enough to reach behind it, and disconnect the ICM electrical connector, if equipped, before removing the panel completely. The supporting illustrations show the optional ICM configuration, the clip locations and the connector behind the panel. Releasing these attachments in order keeps the trim and wiring from competing to hold the panel in place.

edits.text: Remove the highlighted mounting screws, then remove the ICM from the removed finish panel.
edits.why: I use the rear-view illustration to identify the magenta screw heads securing the blue module. The electrical connector was disconnected during finish-panel removal, so this step separates the module from its mounting.

edits.text: Reverse the removal sequence: position the ICM on the finish panel and reinstall its mounting screws. Reconnect the ICM electrical connector, if equipped, then refit the center finish panel and engage its clips. Refit the RH instrument panel trim panel last and engage its clips.
edits.why: Reconnecting the module before seating the center finish panel preserves access to its rear connector. Completion leaves the module secured, its connector engaged where fitted, and both trim panels seated at their clip locations.
